page.overview:
What is Seahorse?

The Seahorse is the ship commanded by Roderick. It served as the base-of-operations for Guts' Traveling Party during the first half of the Fantasia Arc.

The Seahorse is a four-masted, square rigged war galleon bearing 27 guns per side in three gun decks, two foreward chase guns and (presumably) two aft chase guns for a total armament of 58 guns.

The Seahorse has been shown to be a sturdy ship, being able to do battle with three other ships coming at it simultaneously, coming out as the victor.
